sha256Method: sha256 of the published npm tarball, obtained with `npm pack <name>@<version> --pack-destination <dir>` and cross-checked against a direct download of the registry's dist.tarball URL (both bytes-identical). scripts/package-release.mjs --bundle re-derives the same value while packaging and fails when it disagrees with this file.

engines.notes: The platform package is the actual launch target: opencode-ai@1.18.29 only carries a placeholder bin/opencode.exe until its postinstall copies the platform binary over it.

Launch target is the package's own Node entry script dist/bundle/cli.js (`node cli.js --version` answers 0.85.1); there is no native binary and no platform package. Installed with --ignore-scripts, which the entry script does not depend on.
